title: Enter tokens open up model access
summary:
Enter token holders gained broader model access, Bearer-authenticated browser calls got support, and generation responses gained clearer usage counts.

Valid Enter tokens now bypass tier checks for text models and Kontext image generation; Kontext still has a queue interval and concurrency caps. The Pollen FAQ was updated to explain which models frontend and server-to-server keys can access and how daily grants are spent.

Enter API-key authentication now accepts `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, and its image and text proxy routes handle browser preflight requests with that header. The API guide and interactive docs explain and support Bearer authentication.

Image and text responses gained consistent model and token-usage headers when the data is available. Streaming text responses can report usage in HTTP trailers, and image responses now use `x-usage-completion-image-tokens` in place of the older header.

highlights.title: More models with Enter tokens
highlights.text: Valid Enter tokens now bypass tier checks for text models and Kontext image generation. Kontext still has queue and concurrency limits. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Bearer keys for browser calls
highlights.text: Authenticate Enter generation requests with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Its image and text proxy routes also accept browser preflight requests using that header. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Usage counts in responses
highlights.text: Read model and token-usage headers on image and text responses when the data is available. Streaming text responses can provide usage in HTTP trailers. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
